F1_scale_dependence.png.caption: Left: observed richness against library size on log-log axes with fitted slope 0.071. Right: rarefied richness against common rarefaction depth, unsaturating and rising past the raw mean richness at the largest attainable depth.

F2_covariate_association.png.caption: Richness rises and library size falls with the continuous covariate; the opposed signs are visible within every coarse group and survive depth rarefaction.

F3_bias_conditions.png.caption: Condition ordering on the shared 400 metric ids, its empirical CDF including the five exceptions, and the scenario-dependent zero rate in condition_2.

F4_zero_driven_coupling.png.caption: Condition coupling before and after excluding cells where condition_2 equals zero; the residual association in high_variance is the scenario contrast, not a metric-level law.

F5_applicability_boundary.png.caption: The covariate-richness association is confined to the lower half of the covariate range; the same split reappears inside each coarse group when the global median is held fixed.
